Dastardly Duos is a six-week event for level characters that ran during patch 11.1.5 from 3 June to 15 July 2025. Join brave champions in the Dastardly Dome against terrifying villains from Azeroth's past. Compete Vinnie's weekly quest to earn a Champion gear piece, and a unique Dastardly item! Duos participants are ilvl synced down to 619 (Adventurer 4) via the buff. Base camps are located at south of the Contender's Gate PvP area in Dornogal, atop the gatehouse at in the Valley of Heroes of Stormwind, and at atop the Gates of Orgrimmar.

The Dastardly Duos Creator Clash is a single-day showcase that places two guilds head-to-head in the limited-time event, Dastardly Duos. Echo and Team Liquid are competing in a high-profile exhibition match that highlights their skill, teamwork, and strategic mastery. Departing from the usual raid or dungeon race format, this event challenges players to adapt to unpredictable encounters and optimize their performance to claim victory. Select fighters from both guilds battle in Undermine's Demolition Dome, facing legendary bosses from Azeroth's past in a point-based showdown for the coveted title of Warcraft-Weight World Champions.

Deal: Cartel Om is crafted by Khaz Algar scribes who are at least Renown 8 with the Manaforge Vandals. The deal is used alongside Deal: Cartel Ba and Deal: Cartel Zo to find Dead Drops in Manaforge Omega to acquire the Xy Trustee's Gearglider mount and the Cartel Transmorpher toy. Scribes acquire this technique by purchasing Technique: Deal: Cartel Om, a quest reward from A New Recipe! given by Ba'choso at Shadow Point after reaching Renown 8. To craft this technique, use: * 1x Fresh Parchment * 1x Manaforged Instrument (from Forgeweaver Araz) * 25x Apricate Ink

Deathbringer's Shadowcycle is a deathcycle mount that is currently unavailable. Since patch 11.0.5, its source was added as "WoW's 20th Anniversary?" and the mount it teaches was renamed to "Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle" from "Deathbringer's Shadowcycle". Its model was also changed from the violet variant to the green variant. A cycle known as [https://www.wowhead.com/npc=229990 Ratts' Motorcycle] was datamined from patch 11.0.5 which takes on the appearance of the violet deathcycle. The whereabouts of it and if it is available is currently unknown. Ratts was involved with the Incognitro cycle.
